analysis.superiority_rule: Both primary endpoint estimates must be positive and all corresponding Holm p-values < alpha; report each named baseline without selecting the better one.

equivalence.rule: Equivalent only when the whole 90% interval lies strictly inside (-margin, margin); margins fixed 2026-11-05 before any formal result and never adjusted afterwards.

exploratory: debate_engagement_manipulation_check: C/D round-3 self-similarity, quoted opponent share and opponent-evidence uptake (check_pilot.py debate_engagement)
clash_verdict_alignment: whether the Adjudicator's decision follows the majority of its clash_verdicts, and accuracy when it does
development_case_sensitivity: primary results recomputed without the 22 cases in docs/rq-prep/development-cases-20261105.md

change_rule: Pilot may prompt a new version for format, context or failure handling; never select settings from accuracy/Sharpe. Any change invalidates affected qualification and requires a new plan hash.

seed_scope.formal_seeds: RQ2 only; average within case before inference
seed_scope.rq3_inference_seed: RQ3 single protocol; no multi-seed pooling
